name: petfile
description: PETFILE — expediente de salud de mascotas (Grupo ARCA)

scripts.mobile:android: npm run mobile:sync && cap open android
scripts.test: npm run mobile:build && node --test tests/functions.test.cjs tests/security-ui.test.cjs tests/injection.test.cjs tests/injection-ids.test.cjs tests/audit-recetas.test.cjs tests/audit-pets.test.cjs tests/pdf.test.cjs tests/docs.test.cjs tests/signatures.test.cjs tests/space.test.cjs tests/csp.test.cjs tests/concurrency.test.cjs tests/emulator-log.test.cjs tests/write-guard.test.cjs
scripts.test:rules: npx firebase-tools@13 emulators:exec --config firebase.emulator.json --project demo-petfile --only firestore,storage "node tests/emulator/run.cjs"
scripts.test:concurrency: npx firebase-tools@13 emulators:exec --config firebase.emulator.json --project demo-petfile --only firestore,storage "node tests/emulator/run.cjs concurrency"
scripts.test:load: npx firebase-tools@13 emulators:exec --config firebase.emulator.json --project demo-petfile --only firestore,storage "node tests/load/emulator-load.cjs"
